newsitem.title: USA: Micrion Corp says margins under pressure.
newsitem.headline: Micrion Corp says margins under pressure.

text.p: Micrion Corp said on Tuesday that margins for its third quarter ended March 31 had come under pressure due to the product mix and geographic distribution of its systems shipped.

In a statement that accompanied Micrion's third quarter earnings statement, David Hunter, the company's vice president of finance and administration, added that "costs involved in introducing the new 9800 FlipChip system, combined with the costs of establishing a new customer support 'call center' contributed to higher than expected operating costs for the quarter."
Micrion reported that its quarterly net income increased by 22% to $542,000 compared to $446,000 for the same period of fiscal 1996.
Quarterly earnings per share were $0.13 for the third quarter of fiscal 1997 as compared with $0.11 for the third quarter of fiscal 1996.
Micrion Corp, headquartered in Peabody, Mass., designs and markets focused-ion-beam systems for semiconductor and other high technology manufacturers.
